playing.title: Playing
playing.trayLabel: Hide launcher to tray when Minecraft starts
playing.trayDescription: A small icon appears in the system tray. The launcher returns when Minecraft closes; click the tray icon to bring it back sooner.

updates.title: Updates
updates.startupDescription: Shows a notification when a newer version is available. Installing is always an explicit click — Lucerna never updates itself silently.

storage.cacheDescription: Clearing only removes cached jars. Installed mods in instances are not affected. Re-installs will re-download.

about.keyring: Microsoft refresh tokens are stored in the OS keyring (Windows Credential Manager) and removed when you sign out.
